item.text: The sheet already has a one-page print target, but the workbook metadata still has “fit to page” disabled and the columns are wider than needed. I’ll update the workbook’s page setup and column widths, then use LibreOffice in an isolated headless profile so the currently open window does not block the PDF export.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import shutil, tempfile, os

src = Path('/home/user/Resize_Cells_Fit_Page.xlsx')
backup = Path('/home/user/Resize_Cells_Fit_Page.before-fit.xlsx')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(src, backup)

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
ET.register_namespace('', ns['m'])
ET.register_namespace('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('xdr', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing')
ET.register_namespace('x14', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main')
ET.register_namespace('xr2', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2015/revision2')
ET.register_namespace('mc', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')

with ZipFile(src, 'r') as zin:
    entries = {name: zin.read(name) for name in zin.namelist()}

root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
sheetPr = root.find('m:sheetPr', ns)
if sheetPr is None:
    sheetPr = ET.Element(f\"{{{ns['m']}}}sheetPr\")
    root.insert(0, sheetPr)
pageSetUpPr = sheetPr.find('m:pageSetUpPr', ns)
if pageSetUpPr is None:
    pageSetUpPr = ET.SubElement(sheetPr, f\"{{{ns['m']}}}pageSetUpPr\")
pageSetUpPr.set('fitToPage', 'true')

# Tighten only the used columns so both side-by-side day tables remain readable on one page.
cols = root.find('m:cols', ns)
if cols is not None:
    root.remove(cols)
cols = ET.Element(f\"{{{ns['m']}}}cols\")
for min_col, max_col, width in [
    (2, 2, '20.00'), (3, 4, '9.20'),
    (5, 5, '5.00'),
    (6, 6, '20.00'), (7, 8, '9.20'),
]:
    col = ET.SubElement(cols, f\"{{{ns['m']}}}col\")
    col.set('min', str(min_col)); col.set('max', str(max_col))
    col.set('width', width); col.set('customWidth', 'true')
root.insert(list(root).index(root.find('m:sheetData', ns)), cols)

margins = root.find('m:pageMargins', ns)
if margins is None:
    margins = ET.Element(f\"{{{ns['m']}}}pageMargins\")
